newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - PairGain trading lower.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - PairGain trading lower.

text.p: PairGain Technologies Inc fell almost three points in after-hours trading on Wednesday, dealers said after the company released first-quarter results that were slightly short of analysts' expectations.

PairGain was trading at 27 after closing at 29-7/8. After regular trading ended, the company reported first quarter net income of $0.15 per share, up from $0.09 from the same quarter the year before, but below the consensus analysts estimate of $0.17.
During regular trading, PairGain was up 1/8 for the day.
Altera Corp was also trading lower after releasing financial results late Wednesday, dealers said.
Altera was trading at 48-1/2 after the bell, after closing down 7/8 to 49-1/4during regular trading.
Altera reported first quarter fully diluted net income per share of $0.35, compared to $0.33 for the same quarter the year before.

Yahoo! Inc was trading up 9/16 to 35 in late trading after reporting first quarter net income of $0.01 per share, which is above analysts' estimates. Yahoo! had closed at 34-7/16, up 1-3/16 during regular trading hours.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 13,600, compared with 176,600 on Tuesday. Session two volume was 17,510,978, while on Tuesday it was 1,694,400.
